page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top with page number 26 at left. Below it a centred copperplate engraving (emblem picture: a shepherd figure on a pedestal above sheep, a skull and hourglass). Beneath the engraving, a centred four-line italic verse. Signature "Dc" at lower right.

main_text.l: Lanigeras prudenter oues age pasce, tuumq;
Quisua nunc pascit sapienter ovilia, quondam

page.notes: The engraving (a robed figure standing on a pedestal, sheep grazing around it, a skull, crossed bones and an hourglass on a sack at its base, a lit candle at left, hills and a town in the background) is not transcribed as text. Verse lines are set in italic type. Line 3 reads "Quisua" in the scan, with the long s printed as f-like form; transcribed as printed. Line 4 ends with a printed dot after "domum".
